That mean's ye, too, butterfly!" The last referred to Falstad, who bristled at what apparently had to be a harsh insult to one of the Aerie dwarves.</ref> and '''mountain dwarves'''<ref name="DotD35"/> are a type of [[dwarf]] currently centered mainly in the [[Hinterlands]] and the [[Grim Reaches]].

The Wildhammer dwarves are renowned for their close bond with [[gryphon]]s, leading to numerous successes in the [[Second War|Second]] and [[Third War]]s. The bulk of their people are led by the eponymous [[Wildhammer clan]]. The ancient fortress of [[Grim Batol]] was once a massive Wildhammer dwarf city, though it was lost following the [[War of the Three Hammers]].
